title: UGG Hedi Cooling Sheet Set, Split King, Stone Grey

comparisons.notes: Exact title match: UGG Hedi Split King 5-piece, Stone Grey; store SKU matches the same ASIN. Product data shows available at $116.06.

writeup: UGG's Hedi cooling sheet set in Stone Grey, Split King size, is $38.99 new at Woot. It's a five-piece set made for adjustable beds: one flat sheet, two 39x80 fitted sheets with 15-inch pockets and two shams. HomeGlow Spa sells the same set for $116.06, so Woot is about $77 less. Woot showed only a few left, limit 3 per customer.
